sections.name: File setup, domainOf, byDomain
sections.title: Grouping references by website
sections.what: Loads the prepared wind reference data and keeps only the references that have a web link and are admitted as project evidence. It then groups them by website name, with any leading www removed.
sections.why: Likely reason: the app shows publishers, not every individual document.
sections.watch_out: When two references share a website, only the last one listed is kept, so the earlier one disappears from this list.

sections.name: WIND_SOURCE_PACK
sections.title: The wind source list for the app
sections.what: Builds the source pack the app reads. It has one source per website, named after its publisher, in the wind research category, with a fixed authority tier and a description saying that importing does not verify claims.
sections.why: The description states that publisher import does not verify claims, so the app should not present them as checked.
sections.watch_out: Every source gets the same authority tier, so this list does not separate a regulator from a news site.

sections.name: windRegister
sections.title: Report details kept for reference
sections.what: Bundles the batch name, access date, report file name, all references, context, methodology and the full raw report text into one object for other parts of the app.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the provenance description. The data is kept so reviewers can trace claims back to the report.
sections.watch_out: The object carries the full raw report text, so anything that passes it along also passes along the whole report.

summary: Builds the wind source list the app uses, with one source per website for the wind references the report admits as project evidence, and keeps the full report register alongside.
purpose: Presents wind sources in the app's source list, grouped by website rather than by document.
why: Likely reason: one source per website keeps the list short. The description says publisher import does not verify claims.
how: Reads the prepared wind data. Keeps references that have a web link and an admitted scope. Groups them by website name, removing a leading www and lowercasing. Creates one source entry per website with a fixed authority tier. Exports the source pack and the report register.
inputs: The prepared wind data file in the same folder, and the source pack type from the shared sources module.
outputs: The wind source pack, the report register, and the function that gets a website name from a web address.
risks: Several documents from one website become one entry. If two references share a website, the one listed last overwrites the others, so the earlier reference is lost from this list. Every entry gets the same authority tier.
debug: If the source count looks low, check that the scope text begins with Admitted in the prepared data. If an entry shows the wrong document, check the last reference listed for that website.
